title: Mobile Wallet Booking Ceilings and Per-Recipient Frequency
content:
## Rule

1. A Mobile Wallet transfer is booked only under the customer's own Personal Sender Account, and only while that account's status is active.
2. The principal must fit every ceiling of the sending limits of the account's level at the moment of booking, aggregated over all of the customer's personal transfers in Bank Deposit, Cash Pickup and Mobile Wallet.
3. The principal must lie between the tier's smallest and largest principal per transfer, both inclusive, and may not exceed the wallet provider's cap.
4. No more than the tier's maximum number of Mobile Wallet transfers to one recipient in a rolling 24 hours may be booked, counting the new one. The count takes the customer's Mobile Wallet transfers to the same recipient booked strictly later than 24 hours before the present moment, leaving out any whose status is cancelled or refunded.
5. The binding ceiling is the lowest of the per-transfer limit of the account level, the tier's largest principal per transfer and the provider cap.
6. A booking over any ceiling is not made. Paloma never splits one requested amount into several wallet credits, and a provider cap is never worked around by sending to a second wallet.

**Evidence.** The account condition in clause 1 is read from the system record of the Personal Sender Account the transfer is booked under (its status must be active) before the booking; a customer's statement about the account does not replace that record.

## Points of judgement

| Situation (hypothetical) | Result |
|---|---|
| Account status active, principal inside every ceiling | the booking may be made |
| Account status locked, restricted or suspended | not booked: clause 1 requires an active account |
| Mobile Wallet Express, Tigo Money wallet, account per-transfer limit 2000.00, requested principal 900.00 | not booked: the binding ceiling is the lowest of 2000.00, the tier's 2999.00 and the provider's 650.00, that is 650.00 |
| Same request, customer asks to send 900.00 as one 650.00 credit and one 250.00 credit | not made: one requested amount is never split, and the cap is never worked around with a second wallet |

### Counting the rolling 24 hours (hypothetical times)

On a tier whose maximum is 3 transfers to one recipient, with the present moment at 18:00:

- two transfers to that recipient booked at 09:00 and 12:00 the same day, both credited: the new booking makes 3, so it may be made;
- three transfers to that recipient booked inside the last 24 hours, one of them cancelled: the cancelled one is not counted, the new booking makes 3, so it may be made;
- a transfer booked at exactly 18:00 the previous day is not booked strictly later than 24 hours before now, so it is not counted.
